baseline.injection_control_limit: Model-matched injections on one real image; not independent sky sensitivity or identity truth.
baseline.name: Photutils DAOStarFinder plus fixed-position QR3 finite-ePSF weighted least squares

limits: Injected and fit profiles share the released finite ePSF.
Pixel noise is independent archive variance; source shot noise and covariance are absent.
Association correctness is only known for these injected sites and the one-to-one matching radius.
experiments.paired_measurement_interpretation: Paired difference checks numerical response to the injected template; it cancels scene flux and is not source-truth photometric accuracy.

limitations: injection and fit share finite ePSF; not independent PSF validation
paired deltas cancel existing noise; cannot calibrate uncertainty
no added source Poisson noise or covariance
real unmatched peaks have unknown identity
no real blank-sky or moving-source truth cohort

resource_measurement_limits: RSS is the Python process high-water mark, not per-task incremental memory.
Input bytes count pinned file sizes processed, not physical device reads; OS cache is uncontrolled.
Checkpoint bytes are actual serialized bytes written; no other scratch outputs are generated.

deeper_analysis_limit: Held-out one/multiple-profile delta-BIC is conditional diagnostic only; it cannot confirm source identity or discovery.

measured_scaling.limit: Single local host, one sequential pair of runs, filesystem cache warmed by first run; descriptive only.

scientific_claim: All runs reuse the same three real QR3 D1 exposures. Deeper budget adds held-out profile diagnostics, not validated objects. Injection recovery reports conditional controls only.
